articles.text: CHICO: No entiendo que pasa; ya hace dos meses que hiciste la solicitud para la visa.
CHICO: I don't understand what's the matter; it's been two months already since you applied for the visa.
LUIS: Yo tampoco entiendo. A veces pienso que es que no me la quieren dar.
LUIS: I don't understand it either. Sometimes I think it's just that they don't want to give it to me.
CHICO: Voy a hablar con White para ver qué pasa.
CHICO: I'm going to talk with White to see what the trouble is.
LUIS: Ese amigo tuyo me está volviendo loco.
LUIS: That friend of yours is driving me crazy.
